leads.claim: The document discusses the identification of a UFO as either a YF-12A or another Lockheed aircraft, ultimately concluding it was not.
leads.why: The text is a standard administrative discussion regarding the misidentification of a conventional aircraft (YF-12A) and does not describe the recovery or custody of anomalous material.
leads.quote: UFO in fact not YF-12A or similar category Lockheed Aircraft.

doc_verdict: This document does not contain any evidence or suggestions of obtained UAP material; it is a routine administrative clarification regarding the misidentification of conventional aircraft.
